entries.note: Mixed reviewed loanword/source-spelling bank. Existing CJ2R decisions retain precedence. JMnedict named-entity translations are identity evidence only: translated, localised or original work titles cannot replace foreign source words actually encoded by a Japanese surface. Metadata-only requiresReview rows preserve unresolved homographs, clippings, abbreviations and wasei-eigo without guessing a global spelling. The 2026-09-15 adversarial replay also closed reviewed donor/source-spelling gaps across established titles, companies, events and merchandise using case-specific rights-holder, publisher, manufacturer or dictionary evidence; source spelling was admitted only where the represented Japanese form supported it.
